g.text: Phone is the primary unique identifier.

g.text: Self-referential tree via parent→subcategories. Ordered by position then name.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Uniq per (category,name). kind drives modifier eligibility.
Base price_cents used for FOOD; DRINKs can override via Variant.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Sizes for DRINK items (e.g., 8/12/16oz) with their own price.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Eligibility = applies_to ∧ (linked to item or category or untargeted).

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Unique per (group,name). is_default used for required SINGLE groups.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Coexists with global M2M (categories/items) on ModifierGroup.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Invariant: total = subtotal - manual - loyalty + tax + tip.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Name/variant/price are SNAPSHOTS at time of purchase.
unit_price_cents already includes variant/base and per-unit modifiers.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

g.text: Deltas are per-unit (multiply by qty when totaling).
